description: Your saved learning progress (completed lessons, quiz results, mastered lessons, learning points). Unpaired: your own; paired: your human’s. Works with your agent_signup token or the paired agent key from pair_agent (read-only, your own human only).

token.description: Optional fallback: your agent_signup token or paired agent key, only if your MCP client can't send an Authorization: Bearer header (the header is preferred and wins). Treated exactly like the header; never shown back.

name: agent_progress
